visual_reference: The Legend of Korra (quality target: expressive clean 2D acting and cinematic staging; no existing IP assets, likenesses, costumes, lore or animation reused)
world: An original coastal city of suspended observatories, cliff bridges and glass resonance instruments. A broken celestial measuring network makes safe passage impossible.

naya.name: Naya Venn
naya.role: lead navigator and apprentice resonance cartographer
naya.silhouette: athletic grounded stance, angular sleeveless teal outer tunic, asymmetrical cream sash, plum trousers, copper forearm brace; long black braids in topknot with two hanging braids
naya.features: dark brown skin, expressive dark eyes, tightly braided black hair, broad brows, small gold piercings
naya.personality: impatiently brave, protective of Kito, thinks before committing to dangerous power
naya.acting: fights in short decisive arcs; breathes before striking; when scared, her confidence contracts into stillness; no identical animation loops

voice.instruct: Natural young adult woman, warm but clear mid voice, grounded chest resonance, quick impulsive changes when worried, conversational intonation, subtle breaths, believable uncertainty; do not sound like a broadcast narrator. Avoid forced accent stereotypes.
voice.reference_text: No, wait. The bridge isn't broken. It's moving, and I think I know why.

kito.name: Kito Vale
kito.silhouette: short lively pre-teen proportions, curly black hair with honey highlights, oversized ochre scarf, slate-blue shirt, cropped grey trousers, compact brass compass, lightweight handbuilt glider
kito.features: warm medium-brown skin, large expressive eyes, small nose, curly hair, energetic posture
kito.personality: curious, funny, easily excited but genuinely afraid of falling
kito.acting: quick changes of thought, fidgety fingertips, sudden gestures then shy retreat; physically shorter and lighter than adults

voice.instruct: A believable pre-teen boy, light youthful non-booming timbre, bright conversational vowels, energetic but not helium-pitched, uneven excitement, audible quick breaths before long thoughts, shy hesitation when afraid; no adult announcer cadence or cartoon baby voice.
voice.reference_text: I made the glider myself! Well... most of it. Please don't ask about the wings.

tovan.name: Tovan Rusk
tovan.silhouette: tall broad-shouldered silhouette, layered charcoal indigo coat, moss green scarf, chest harness, worn leather belt, large practical hands
tovan.features: deep brown skin, short salt-and-pepper hair, full trimmed graying beard, measured gaze
tovan.personality: patient, dry humor, hard-won protectiveness, distrusts reckless plans
tovan.acting: few but meaningful gestures, weighty movement, slow head turns; emotional shifts in the eyes

voice.instruct: Believable mature male speaking voice with gently rough low-mid register, measured conversational breath pacing, warm authority, dry wit, quiet protective urgency; not gravelly movie-trailer narration.
voice.reference_text: That's the trouble with old bridges. They remember every mistake we make.

serin.name: Serin Hal
serin.role: strategist and keeper of the damaged observatory
serin.silhouette: erect narrow posture, burgundy high-collar blouse, navy long mantle with gold embroidered celestial geometry, brass handheld astrolabe
serin.features: light olive skin, swept-back dark hair with a bold white streak, sharp dark eyes, reserved expression
serin.personality: meticulous, withholding information out of guilt, fiercely loyal underneath
serin.acting: precise deliberate hand movements, watches others before responding, visible pauses before difficult truths

voice.instruct: Naturally mature female speaking voice, precise and calm with a warm low-mid timbre, thoughtful hesitations, audible emotional restraint, uses measured pauses for meaning; do not read like a documentary announcer.
voice.reference_text: I know what the Meridian is hiding. I was there when it first went dark.
